title: Marrowkeep moves to the Moors
changes: Marrowkeep, the Host capital, now stands in the Grey Barrow Moors, north of Kingsbarrow. The Barrow-King's Mound lies just below its south wall. Its south gate opens onto the paved Moors Highway down to the Host's Muster and on to Cairnwatch, and its west gate onto a short track toward the Nine Widows road.
Gate wardens turn away heroes under level 5, heroes at war with the Host and heroes Wanted by them. The city's waystone keeps the same rules.
The old waygate to Marrowkeep is gone.
